tasks.title: Add displayName to summary()
tasks.intent: Change lib/summary.mjs to return { name: user.name, displayName: user.name.toUpperCase() }, keeping the name field and its value intact for compatibility.

tasks.title: Update summary test for the new field
tasks.intent: Update tests/summary.test.mjs: the existing deepEqual asserts the exact object shape { name: "ada" }, which the intentionally-added displayName field changes, so the expectation becomes { name: "ada", displayName: "ADA" }. Add a separate assertion that the name field is still present with its original value, pinning the compatibility half of API-001. Without this task the API-001-A suite run cannot be green.

tasks.title: Run suite for API-001-A acceptance
tasks.intent: Run node --test "tests/*.test.mjs" and require exit code 0, executing the updated tests that pin both the displayName addition and the preserved name field.

observations.statement: tests/summary.test.mjs uses assert.deepEqual on the exact returned shape, so the new field necessarily invalidates the old expectation; the spec's "name remains" requirement is preserved by keeping the field and value, and by the new dedicated name assertion.
